primarySourceUnavailable.reason: csca.cn returned an empty shell; cucas.cn serves an obfuscated anti-bot payload in place of the syllabus PDF; csca.app returned HTTP 429; crosslineedu.com returned HTTP 403.
primarySourceUnavailable.consequence: Nothing here is a first-party CSCA document. A topic is marked verified:true only where at least two independent sources agree AND it is visible in the reference corpus. Everything else is verified:false with a note saying why.

strands.name: Sets and Inequalities
strands.officialWording: Module 1: Sets and Inequalities — 8 questions (17%). Set operations; linear inequalities; absolute value inequalities.

subtopics.name: Properties of inequalities and the AM-GM inequality

strands.name: Functions and Sequences
strands.officialWording: Module 2: Functions and Sequences — 16 questions (33%). Function properties (domain, range, monotonicity, parity, periodicity); linear, quadratic, exponential and logarithmic functions; arithmetic and geometric sequences; derivatives.

topics.name: Trigonometry
topics.note: The module heading names only linear, quadratic, exponential and logarithmic functions, but the formula sheet devotes a full section to trigonometry and every past paper in the corpus is dense with it.

subtopics.name: Definitions, radians and the unit circle
Identities for the same angle and reduction formulae
Sum, difference, double- and half-angle formulae
Solving triangles: sine rule, cosine rule and area
General terms, recurrences and S(n) relations
Limits and the definition of the derivative

strands.name: Geometry and Algebra
strands.officialWording: Module 3: Geometry and Algebra — 14 questions (29%). Plane geometry (triangles, circles, polygons; area and perimeter); analytic geometry (lines, circles, parabolas, ellipses, hyperbolas); vectors; systems of linear equations.

subtopics.name: Slope, angle of inclination and equations of lines
Points, quadrants and distance in the plane
Plane vectors: addition, subtraction and scalar multiples

topics.name: Complex Numbers
topics.note: Named in the China Admissions reproduction of the official syllabus and present in the reference papers, but absent from the module headings and the formula sheet. Included at low weight because it has actually been examined.

strands.name: Probability and Statistics
strands.officialWording: Module 4: Probability and Statistics — 10 questions (21%). Classical probability (basic events, sample space, probability formulae); mean and variance; normal distribution.

subtopics.name: Mutually exclusive, complementary and independent events

strands.name: Mechanics
strands.officialWording: Module 1: Mechanics — 14 questions (29%). Displacement, velocity, acceleration, uniform linear motion and free fall; Newton's laws and applications; momentum and impulse, momentum conservation; work and energy, mechanical energy conservation; circular motion and centripetal force; simple harmonic motion and mechanical waves.

subtopics.name: Scalars, vectors and frames of reference
Uniformly accelerated motion in a straight line
Kinetic energy and the work-energy theorem
Circular motion: angular velocity, period and centripetal force
Mechanical waves: speed, frequency and wavelength

strands.name: Electromagnetism
strands.officialWording: Module 2: Electromagnetism — 12 questions (25%). Coulomb's law: electric field strength and electric potential; Ohm's law: series-parallel circuits, power calculations; magnetic induction: Ampere's force, Lorentz force; electromagnetic induction: Faraday's law, Lenz's law.

subtopics.name: Charge, conservation of charge and Coulomb's law
Electric field strength and field lines
Potential difference and work done by the electric force
Capacitance and capacitors
subtopics.note: Present in the reference corpus but not named in any module heading.

subtopics.name: Electrical power, energy and electromotive force
Magnetic flux density and magnetic flux
The Lorentz force and charged particles in a field
Lenz's law and the direction of induced current

strands.name: Thermodynamics
strands.officialWording: Module 3: Thermodynamics — 6 questions (13%). Kinetic theory of gases; ideal gas state equation; first law of thermodynamics.

subtopics.name: Kinetic theory, Brownian motion and intermolecular forces
Gas laws and the ideal gas equation
Internal energy and the first law of thermodynamics

strands.name: Optics
strands.officialWording: Module 4: Optics — 8 questions (17%). Geometrical optics: reflection, refraction and imaging. Physical optics: interference and diffraction.

subtopics.name: Total internal reflection and the critical angle
Diffraction and the wave nature of light

strands.name: Modern Physics
strands.officialWording: Module 5: Modern Physics — 8 questions (17%). Photoelectric effect (E = hf - W); atomic structure: Bohr model, energy levels, electron transitions, spectral lines; nuclear physics: mass defect, binding energy, nuclear reactions, radioactive decay.

subtopics.name: Photon energy and the wave-particle picture
The photoelectric equation and work function
The Bohr model, energy levels and spectral lines
Mass defect, binding energy and mass-energy equivalence
